subject: Request: staggered variant lock & rollout window for RetailCo production
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: staggered variant lock & rollout window for RetailCo production

Hi team,

Quick heads-up — RetailCo is aiming to flip traffic to our hosted inference route for the new recommendation flow on Aug 2. They've completed integration testing and want a predictable runtime surface while they ramp. They asked if we can "lock" the variant served to their account to the Orion-XL@v1.2 variant while we run a staggered rollout for the more experimental Orion-XL@v1.3.

Ask: can we create a short-lived variant lock (30 days) for RetailCo's account that pins Orion-XL@v1.2 on their production routes, with an internal canary that allows up to 5% traffic to hit v1.3 in a controlled window starting Jul 27? If we see stability/latency regressions we should be able to instant rollback to the pinned variant.

What I need from infra/product/security:
- Laura / Karthik: confirmation that we can apply a per-account variant pin + canary policy in the routing layer and timeline (ETA on config + verification).
- Evelyn: telemetry checklist — which traces/metrics and alert thresholds you want for the canary (latency P95, error rate, kv cache behavior).
- Legal/Procurement: Samir (edge ops) and RetailCo legal will be looped for the contract addendum — scope and SLA exceptions.

I've attached our variant evaluation CSV and the safety report RetailCo asked for. I'll also draft a staggered rollout runbook if you confirm this approach.

Thanks,
Mateo
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- variant_evaluation.csv (text/csv)
- safety_report.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: staggered variant lock & rollout window for RetailCo production

Mateo — thanks for the clear ask. High-level response below.

We can implement a per-account route override that pins a variant and separately configure a canary bucket. Operational notes:
- ETA: config + infra rollout takes ~3 business days (we'll target Jul 22 for config, Jul 23 for verification in staging).
- Canary config: we can do progressive ramping (1% -> 3% -> 5%) over 48h with automatic rollback on preset alerts.
- Rollback surface: instant route switch to pinned variant; KV cache priming will be cold for ~200ms on first requests — call that out to RetailCo.

Questions for Mateo:
1) Do we want the canary to run only in US region? RetailCo's traffic is currently 92% US.
2) What SLA exceptions does RetailCo expect for the 30-day lock window (e.g., commitments on latency P95 / incidents)?

I'll reserve a staging window on Jul 23 and will run a quick integration test with RetailCo's stubbed traffic. Karthik, can you confirm we have capacity in the dedicated pool on Jul 27 in case they need reserved throughput?

—Laura
Director, Product Ops | Redwood Inference

From: Dana Park <dana@retailco.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: RetailCo Legal <legal@retailco.com>, Samir Khan <samir@edgeops.net>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 12:41:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: staggered variant lock & rollout window for RetailCo production

Hi Mateo / Laura — thanks, this plan sounds reasonable. RetailCo is happy to accept a 30-day pinned variant on Orion-XL@v1.2 while you run the canary for v1.3. A few clarifications from our side:

- Region: please limit the canary to US traffic only.
- SLA: during the 30-day pin we need a 99.5% availability commitment for the pinned route; for canary traffic we'll accept standard hosted SLAs but expect quick rollback on any error spike >0.5% over 15 minutes.
- Legal: we've attached a short addendum template for the pin and the expected performance thresholds. Can your procurement team review and return?

We'll be in staging on Jul 23 for the integration test. If everything looks good we'll start production ramp on Aug 2 at 00:00 UTC.

Best,
Dana Park
VP, Engineering — RetailCo

Attachment referenced: retailco_pin_addendum.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Park <dana@retailco.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@edgeops.net>, RetailCo Legal <legal@retailco.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Jul 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: staggered variant lock & rollout window for RetailCo production

Perfect — thanks Dana. Confirming next steps and owners: 

- Jul 22: Infra (Karthik) will push per-account route config for pin + canary. Karthik: please ping here when config lands.
- Jul 23: Staging integration test (Laura + RetailCo). Runbook link: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/retailco/orion-rollout (I've copied the initial runbook and the rollback playbook).
- Jul 27: Begin controlled canary (US-only): 1% -> 3% -> 5% over 48h. Evelyn: telemetry alert thresholds requested: P95 latency > 450ms OR error rate > 0.5% over 15m should trigger auto-rollback.
- Aug 2 00:00 UTC: production ramp to full — RetailCo to confirm final ramp schedule during staging.
- Legal/Procurement (Samir): please review the attached RetailCo addendum and DocuSign link (https://docusign.com/RC-2027-118/env-lock). We need the signed addendum before Jul 27 to proceed with canary.

I've attached the runbook and the latest evaluation artifacts. If we get sign-off by EOD Jul 23 we'll lock the variant with the agreed windows and telemetry.

Thanks all — I'll update the status board and create a short Slack channel for quick incident coordination (will post link in the runbook).

Mateo
Product Partnerships | Redwood Inference
